description: This line plot illustrates the validation performance, measured in BPC, of two models, XMoE and SimSMoE, across a series of training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps ($\times 10^3$)" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "BPC" and uses a linear scale with a visible range from approximately 1.1 to 2.25, featuring tick marks at intervals of 0.25 (1.25, 1.50, 1.75, and 2.00). The plot contains two solid lines. The line representing "XMoE Validating" is olive green with cross markers. It begins at a peak value of approximately 2.25 at 0 training steps, experiences a sharp decline to roughly 1.32 at 10 steps, continues to decrease to about 1.19 at 20 steps, and then levels off into a relatively steady trend, ending at approximately 1.17 near 50 steps. The line representing "SimSMoE Validating" is magenta with circular dot markers. It also starts at approximately 2.25 at 0 steps, follows a similar sharp initial decline to roughly 1.28 at 10 steps and 1.16 at 20 steps, before flattening out into a steady trend to end at approximately 1.12 near 50 steps.
